caption: The drawing shows a basket with a slightly conical or trapezoidal shape, topped with a loosely placed lid. The basket is colored in light brown and tan hues, with darker brown accents to suggest shading and texture. The body of the basket features a decorative design: two large stylized floral or starburst patterns on the front, along with a zigzag border on the left and the right sides composed of diamond shapes. The lid is oval and matches the rest of the basket in its brown coloring, with shading to indicate depth and curvature. The basket is drawn resting on a flat surface, with a shadow beneath it. The background is plain and uncolored. Below the drawing, there is handwritten text in pencil detailing information about the basket's origin and description.
title: Basket
